assets.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Create a finished polished Hungarian Facebook feed advertisement in 4:5 portrait aspect ratio. Use the provided oak staircase photograph as the main photographic element; preserve its believable architectural details, pale natural oak materials, realistic staircase geometry, and elegant black balustrade. Crop and position the photograph to fit a full bleed central section.
Brand: Hungarian oak timber supplier, sophisticated architecture editorial visual identity. Deep forest green #173D31, cream #F6F3EA, natural oak.
Design: clean premium advertisement, elegant large serif headline in dark green on a cream upper panel; the photo across the middle; forest green lower panel with cream text, cream CTA button and URL below. Generous margins on all sides. No decorative clutter. Clearly readable on a phone.
Text to include exactly, in this hierarchy:
"TÖLGYFA LÉPCSŐT TERVEZEL?"
"Prémium alapanyag közvetlenül a gyártótól."
"Beszerelést nem vállalunk."
"Kérj ajánlatot!"
"tolgyalapanyag.hu/lepcso"
The headline must be largest and can wrap to three lines. Put the premium manufacturer line in clearly readable type. The installation limitation must be readable, not hidden or tiny. CTA "Kérj ajánlatot!" in a distinct cream button. Domain at bottom within safe margins. Precisely preserve every Hungarian accent.
Constraints: exactly these five items and no other copy, no invented logo, no real portfolio claim, no people, no watermark, no device mockup, no cropped text. Finished flat full-bleed advertisement.
assets.recompositionPrompt: Recompose this exact finished advertisement into a 4:5 portrait canvas. Preserve every word of its Hungarian copy, accents, URL, forest green and cream palette, and staircase photograph. Reduce headline size modestly and reduce the central photograph height so all copy and image fit the shorter 4:5 layout. Do NOT just cut off any text. Professionally reflow the design on the new canvas. Keep generous margins, strong text hierarchy and large readable copy. Exact output canvas aspect ratio 4 width : 5 height.
